EXPLORE NORTHUMBERLAND

Places worth getting to know.

From historic castles and coastal villages to beautiful market towns and quiet countryside, discover some of the places that make Northumberland special.

Coast ★★★★★

Bamburgh

A spectacular coastal village overlooked by one of England's most iconic castles, with miles of sandy beach and some of Northumberland's finest scenery.

Historic ★★★★★

Alnwick

A historic market town famous for its castle, gardens and charming streets.

Villages ★★★★★

Warkworth

A beautiful historic village wrapped around an impressive medieval castle and the River Coquet.
